title: "V1010 unknown_attribute"

An error from the `resolve` phase. `sakura explain V1010` prints this explanation offline.

Only these attributes exist in v0: `@tool`, `@llm`, `@external`, `@total`, `@contract_test`,
`@deprecated`, `@server`, `@test_only` on items, and `@trust("reason")` as an expression
(design §2.5). Any other attribute is unknown, any attribute but `@trust` in expression position
is rejected, and `Tool.of` takes only a function declared with `@tool` (§11.2).

Wrong:

```sakura
@pure
fn double(n: Int) -> Int { n * 2 }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn double(n: Int) -> Int { n * 2 }
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V1010_tool_of_lambda.fixed.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V1010_tool_of_lambda.fixed.sakura), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

@tool("Doubles a number.")
pub fn double(a: Int) -> Int { a * 2 }

pub fn tools() -> Unit { let _ = Tool.of(double) }
